Computed tomography (CT) coronary artery imaging, also known as coronary CT angiography (CCTA), is a non-invasive diagnostic technique used to visualize coronary arteries and detect stenosis, plaques, or other cardiovascular abnormalities. It uses contrast-enhanced imaging to provide detailed cross-sectional views of the heart and blood vessels.
